The '''SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm''' is a {{Special}} [[Rift Timecharms|Rift Timecharm]].

== Obtaining ==
The player can purchase a '''SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm''' from the [[Barry HQ#Old Election Box|Old Election Box]] in {{zone|Barry HQ}} for {{Item|Scribe Crux|amount=16}} and {{Item|Barry's Montgray Pen|amount=1}} after helping {{NPCSprite|Barry}} with all the protestors.

== Usage ==
The player can secure the '''SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm''' in the {{zone|Rift Gallery}} to unlock access to the {{zone|Living Cave}} and thus the {{zone|Living Stillness}}.

=== Game Message ===
Securing the '''SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm''' will result in the following message, which will be broadcast to the entire lobby:
{{TextSection|boxed=true|text={{Dialogue|&d&lRIFTASTIC! &7[player] &ehas secured &cSkyBlock Citizen Timecharm&e into their gallery! &6gg&e!}}}}
=== Rift Necklace ===
{{Main|Rift Necklace}}
Securing the '''SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm''' will add additional [[stats]] to the [[Rift Necklace]] both inside and outside the [[Rift Dimension]].
